values.note: USFS: 'Open Mid-March to Late November'. Drinking water may be off when average temperatures are near or below freezing.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/north-creek-campground ('Seasons of Use: Mid-March - late-November', 'Open Mid-March to Late November'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: $15 per single site per night; $30 for the double site (maximum 12 people). Paid on site at the self-service kiosk, cash or check.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/north-creek-campground ('Single Site: $15 per night', 'Double Site: $30 per night', 'Fees are paid on site at the self-service kiosk, be prepared to pay cash or check'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'This location is only available on a first-come, first-serve basis. Reservations are not accepted.' Pay at the self-service kiosk on arrival.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/north-creek-campground ('Vault toilet(s)', 'Potable water is available at this site'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'The America the Beautiful Senior and Access Pass provides a 50% discount to the base campsite fee. No other America the Beautiful Interagency passes are valid.'

summary: Confirmed on the USFS page: $15/night single site ($30 double), FCFS only with kiosk payment, Senior/Access 50% off. Added season mid-March to late November (no exact dates published), vault toilets and potable water. Not stated: site count, hookups (none listed), rig length.
